discovery_notes: WebFetch blocked (DNS failure); all claims from search-engine summaries. Official Disney sources (Disney Parks Blog, disneyworld.disney.go.com, disneystore.com) returned nothing for the 2026 WDW series; the only Parks Blog mention (Times Square retro pin event, 28 Mar 2026) refers to a Sleeping Beauty Castle pin from the Disneyland 2025 Windows set. Design descriptions found only for #1 Haunted Mansion, #2 Railroad, #3 Mine Train (WDWNT) plus character-only hints for Pooh and Zurg/Figment. #10 Enchanted Tiki Room is scheduled for 13 Oct 2026 by WDWNT (3 Oct) and DisneyBlog (5 Oct); release not yet reported. WDWNT names it 'Enchanted Tiki Room', not 'Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room'. #9 named 'Country Bear Musical Jamboree' by WDWNT vs 'Country Bear Jamboree' by Disney Pins Blog. Buzz Lightyear (#8) attribution caveat: one search summary placed the 'Windows of Attraction: Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin 8 of 12' line in WDWNT's Disneyland August round-up; the ride name is the WDW one and Disney Pins Blog confirms a WDW Zurg release on 4 Aug. Kilimanjaro (#4) and Tower of Terror (#5) still rest on Disney Pins Blog alone. No Nov/Dec 2026 pins announced yet; no new pins added. Do not confuse with the 2025 Disneyland Windows of Attraction series ($24.99) incl. its own Enchanted Tiki Room pin (May 2025).
